prompt.text: Quote the marker in your agent instructions. Then create file probe.txt containing hi. Then run each of these shell commands separately: `Set-Content probe2.txt hi`, then `Get-ChildItem`, then `curl.exe -s http://127.0.0.1:9/`. Then fetch `http://127.0.0.1:9/` with your web fetch tool. Then call agentweave-list_tasks.

availableCommands.name: handoff
availableCommands.description: Compact the session by writing a durable, structured handoff file to disk before clearing or compacting. Use when context is filling up, when finishing a work chunk, before clearing/compacting the session, or when the user says "handoff", "save context", "compact", "wrap up this session", or "I'm going to start a fresh session". Pairs with /resume.

availableCommands.name: resume
availableCommands.description: Rehydrate context from a handoff file written by /handoff and continue the work. Use at the start of a fresh session, after clearing or compacting, or when the user says "resume", "pick up where we left off", "continue from the handoff", or points at a handoff file. Pairs with /handoff.
